theorems.name: Submission.p04_tia_tate_neg_one_transfer
theorems.statement: ∀ {k G : Type _} [CommRing k] [Group G] [Fintype G] (A : Rep k G) (H : Subgroup G) [Fintype H], ∃ T : A.tateHneg1 →ₗ[k] (Rep.res H.subtype A).tateHneg1, ∃ P : (Rep.res H.subtype A).tateHneg1 →ₗ[k] A.tateHneg1, ∀ x : A.tateHneg1, P (T x) = H.index • x
theorems.natural_summary: Sum over right-coset representatives to construct transfer on coinvariants; the natural projection composed with transfer is multiplication by the index. Right- and left-transversal norm identities show that both maps preserve the respective norm kernels. Restricting the maps and their composite identity gives the result.
